title: Payment recovery studio
summary: Make interrupted payments recoverable without charging a customer twice.

brief.outcome: Resume every interrupted payment from durable state.
users: Customers returning after an interrupted checkout
constraints: Never retry an unknown charge blindly
Keep canonical state outside the repository

requirements.text: Reconcile an ambiguous provider response before retry.

architecture.overview: A durable controller records intent, invokes the provider, then reconciles its receipt.

acceptance_criteria.text: A crash after send resumes as unknown, not failed.
A non-idempotent provider is never retried automatically.

critiques.finding: A timeout is not evidence that the provider did nothing.

decisions.title: Require provider lookup after ambiguous send

verification.name: Timeout behavior
verification.evidence: Two runs disagree about the returned provider state.

evidence.name: Crash-window transcript
evidence.detail: Bound to the current source digest.

gaps: Rollback drill has not been observed on the provider sandbox.
